和一代差别不大，游玩思路也大差不差，个别体验比如怪物巢穴直接给你视野，能够要求亡灵回防基地，能够要求自己找巢穴端掉，我觉得这些都是不错的。但是，但是游戏策划，第二波boss，两个巨人、、、、谁打的赢，巢穴突然从1500的血飙升到10000，这种跳跃像不像你模拟考试都刚及格，你母上大人就要求考清华。 整体来说，暂时还不值得，等调整好吧。 -------------------发布后第二天分割线----------------- 今天爬起来想想反思，是不是我自己游戏打得臭，毕竟别人搞游戏也是深思熟虑的 把第一张地图过了，出了个近战巨人，硬怼10000血的巢穴，原来打掉就问你要不要过关了，我想着不是还有两个巨人boss嘛，就说放弃过关，去会会巨人，然后我就躺下了。。。。好吧是我孟浪了 总体上平衡上是有提升，几只蜥蜴是能守住小兵的。 进入第二关， 额。。。。。船新的版本，新零件来了，多巴胺来了，然后10000血的巢穴就变成了常规配置了。。。。。。。。然后，我默默地关闭了游戏。 还是建议开发者能够自己玩玩游戏，尤其是数值策划，突然的死亡还是有点心情低落。 游戏过程也是比较手忙脚乱，各种零件的区别也不是很明显，也没有分类，到了后期，真心是一大锅 。组合出标准配置是挺棒的，但是这些零件之间的区别太模糊了，我初步理解了应该有：普通、魔法、盔甲三类零件，但是好难区分，再加上后期一大堆。。。。心好累。 ------------2024-4-7---------昨晚看到重大更新，还是没放弃----------- 这次打了几局，对巨人的依赖减少了很多，但是boss还是得巨人抗。分类什么的也是好评，至少不用满天的找零件，数值也相对优化了些吧，总体来说制作组属于听劝型。 看到更新里面有什么优化了迎战逻辑，好家伙，这个真的小拉屁股了，大家人均帕金森，抖个不停 。是外面的世界诱惑太多了吗，一个空旷的区域，一个最低等级的骷髅，捡个资源你犹豫什么，是耽误你和大boss的pk了吗？？？？？？旁边去拆房子的大部队，早上出门，太阳都下山了还在家门口。。。。。这是舍不得家里的娇妻吗。。。。 玩到后期，确实缺少目标感，玩这个游戏是为了啥，堆来一堆功能差不多的小怪刷金币，刷出跟数值更厉害的技能和零件，然后过关。 顺便回复一下评论区的未成年人，喷数值策划不需要证明自己玩的好不好。这是一个开放的游戏，如果过关要靠重复的套路刷刷刷，未免游戏策划也该被喷

没有任何意义的法力资源，没有任何意义的种族设计，没有任何意义的宝物设计系统。所有的一切糅合了这个我怀疑制作组根本不玩的游戏。稳定通第三关的我有发言权吧？很多细节上的设计让我想起了当年高数考试最后一题抓耳挠腮死活下不去笔，最后只能放弃写了一个解，试图能够拿到个1分2分。设计组的一切都在努力表明，我们认真用心做了细节和设定。但是在糟糕的经济系统和数值系统上面，一切都不重要。因为没有意义，甚至连地图资源的配置系统都是一坨，为了激活一套的图纸奖励，我开个天龙差个翅膀，然后我却有30个头20个身体50条腿，但是一张地图我只找到了一个翅膀，就仿佛你点了一只烤鸡却在里面吃出了3个鸡头的恶心感。这个游戏根本不该发售出来，要不就是设计者没有玩过游戏，或者知道这个糟糕透顶的一坨还拿出来骗钱。我只能说这个设计组真的要不蠢要不坏了。如果你看到这个评论，快跑，这玩意就是骗你钱的！

[table] [tr] [th]游戏由SteamPY鉴赏家提供[/th] [/tr] [tr] [td]SteamPY鉴赏家[/td] [/tr] [tr] [td][h3]上SteamPY淘海量超低价游戏[/h3][/td] [/tr] [/table] [h1]在《缝合怪模拟器2》的故事中，我们的“缝合”大师，带着愚蠢的亡灵还有猫猫又踏上了新的区域（圆盘）！在这些新区域又会有怎样的敌人在等待着我们呢？让我们把所有机器启动，启动，启动吧！[/h1] 游戏的体量依旧不大，跟前作相比，制作时间并不长，新增内容有限，成就的获取依旧相当友好！这点必须好评！ 前期每当失败或者进入新区域之前，猫猫总会在不经意之间对主人进行最为致命的吐槽 ——主人：你在教我做事？真是狗改不了吃屎，猫改不了（？） ——猫猫：喵喵喵？ 先来说说跟上一作相比，新增的内容： 1.亡灵增加了具体指令：比如进攻巢穴、进攻生物、区域巡逻、防守城堡、搜刮资源。（让它们看起来聪明了那么一点） 2.增加了泰坦：制造泰坦不仅需要魔力，还需要大量的身体部位，根据部位所含成分：骸骨、血肉、魔力、机械等进行添加熔炼，且已熔炼的部位无法返还。（什么泰坦？还不是巨型缝合怪） 3.可攻略区域变为三个（加上混沌模式，应该算四个），当再次游玩已攻略区域时，摧毁所有敌方巢穴或者单局游戏达到一定时间后，会出现“死神”——“死神”一经出现即意味着强制结束游戏（上个版本的死神可以杀死，当前版本的死神杀不死）。 [u]对于没接触前作，直接游玩本作的朋友，需要注意： 1.三种主要资源中，只有金币属于可保留资源，其余两种资源只在当前局可使用。 2.优先升级能产出部件的设施！优先升级能产出部件的设施！优先升级能产出部件的设施！重要的话说三遍！！！每天都能产出特定生物指定数量的身体部位——此升级项目决定了你的游戏进程。 3.当我方单位处于敌方巢穴的视野内（敌方巢穴的视野远远大于我方单位的视野），敌方巢穴开始刷兵，敌方单位优先进攻我方单位，其次才是我方大本营。在本作中，哪怕不探索触发敌方巢穴，敌方巢穴也会在固定时间开始刷兵，且兵种强度在当前普通的缝合怪之上。 4.抵抗住第一波敌方单位最有效的方法就是尽快收集资源，以身体部件为主，尽早造出泰坦，每局第一个泰坦通常都是用来守家的。泰坦身体部件的图纸均为小BOSS产出，只要造出一定强度的泰坦，在第一波小BOSS来袭之前就算稳了。造不出？你连第一波小怪都守不住。除非耗费大量主动法术配合高强度单位摧毁敌方巢穴。 5.找到神器后，并不是立即生效，本作则需要在战前放置在祭坛上才能生效，最多可同时装备4件神器。 6.造出泰坦守家后，也请尽快收集高级部件（越靠近地图外围，部件的等级越高）制造出更多更高级的缝合怪（用配方制造的缝合怪会有额外属性加成）——游戏本质上就是抢时间，出高级兵。[/u] 性价比方面，当前类似的像素游戏首发定价在这个区间算是较为合理的了。如果不是游戏荒，可以蹲个史低，不推荐原价购入。 喜欢这类游戏且没玩过前作的，建议从前作补票（前作进过包）。 由于前作的情怀加成，还有怀念当初作为“缝合”大师的那股新鲜感，我又一次听从猫猫的怂恿，毅然踏入了不归之地！

有一定可玩性的塔防，但难度曲线上升较快，每到一张新图就有卡关的感觉，只能回前面刷资源。 内容量方面，自己能合成的怪物种类非常丰富，除了传统的不死者，像霜巨人、树人、夺心魔这些神话、异形生物也可以用，更可以缝合不同种族的尸体构建奇特的亡灵，一共有三百多种配方。 但是......制作组貌似完全把工作量都堆在做仆从上面了，导致地图和boss并不多。另外，作为一个小作坊游戏，画面也是比较古老的。 如果是非常喜欢亡灵题材的人，可以在折扣时尝试一下。20元玩个10小时还是可以的。 对题材没特殊喜好的则不推荐。 ====================================================== [b]游玩建议：[/b] 1. 泰坦巨人不要被动的放在家里，保证有一个在外面游荡拆敌人家更好。不过也不用急着打光，可以留一些敌人城市来刷金币。 2. 神器的选择，加移速、生命的会更好一些，对初期的发展帮助较大。 （友军死亡时给队友回血的神器非常适合帮助泰坦对抗boss） 3. 基地升级，开局优先提升哈比女妖和蜥蜴人的部件生产，然后补一些攻击、治疗法术，之后提升泰坦的数量。 哈比女妖是非常优秀的采集者和清杂输出手，对第二张图来说是必要的。蜥蜴人的尸体供应可以保证血肉巨人的生产。 4. 第二关开局需要手动操控仆从去尽快获得更多部件，用哈比翅膀制作飞行仆从即可守住塔度过开局。（只需要翅膀的攻击模组，身体用蜥蜴人或者人类僵尸都行） 没有魔力就烧掉一些用不上的部件即可。 5. 留几个城市不杀以尽量拖延死神出现的时间，可以用这个方式在第二关刷金币。最后一关第一次打的时候找个有霜巨人尸体的开局，在第二个夜晚到来时快速出有吸血能力的泰坦即可正常打了。

Essentially, you get body parts semi-randomly and you slap them together, give them an order for what to do, and then set them free. The creations aren't particularly interesting, it doesn't really have a lot of depth, it's a terrible grind, and runs have to be completed all at once because you can't save. It's a huge time sink for less engagement than reading a book that ultimately fails to deliver on the necromancer fantasy in any meaningful way. The loop is play -> earn gold -> die (because you don't have upgrades to make winning possible) -> spend gold to upgrade -> keep replaying the same map until you've gotten enough upgrades and get lucky on enemy titan spawns -> move on to the next world.

If not for that, this game would get a thumbs up, but it's bad enough that by itself it earns a thumbs down. Otherwise a fairly fun game, I suppose. Update. I played a bit more. Apparently if you take too long on a level it sends a reaper that instakills you. This reaper cannot be killed, and can kill anything and everything you have (I checked the forums, it's unbeatable). I have no idea why. Enjoying the progress then unstoppable death seems kind of antifun.

To start, Necrosmith 2 feels like the first game on half-time. The movement of in game troops, alongside the slowly animated UI and the requirement to press multiple buttons to make selection choices is increasingly atrocious. For instance, having to press two buttons to confirm building structures: In the first game, resources were gained fast enough that building was actually fun and happened at a quick enough pace that a confirmation button was practically useless. That, alongside the resource collection speed makes this game's building system feel like being stuck in the mud. The movement and in turn resource collection speed of the troops is really the main point of contention for me. However, the progression -- while not as bad, also feels extremely sluggish. There is practically no replay-ability because of how painfully slow the games is -- you find yourself not wanting to play a map more than a few times, yet the progression seems to be reliant on it. Each successful run is 30 minutes long at minimum, and in the first game that was not only enjoyable, but also made the lack of a save option tolerable. I don't want to spend an hour watching slow moving troops and slow spell reset timers tick up only to have to do something else outside of the game and leave my computer running for hours. Necrosmith 2 is simply not as engaging and feels like a serious downgrade from the previous game. I've played this game significantly longer than 2.5 hours -- there's no wifi on car rides.

[h1]Is this UE 4 or PowerPoint presentation?[/h1] Once you’ve uncovered around 70–75% of a large map, the framerate doesn’t just drop — it quietly lies down like a tired elk and refuses to get back up. We’re talking 0–1 FPS, the kind of slideshow you’d expect from an ancient laptop running in a wooden cabin with three meters of snow on the roof. The rest of the game sits in that strange comfort zone between “fine” and “why bother”. The grind is tolerable, the so-called “hidden” recipes are about as secret as the sun in midsummer, and the difficulty curve is flatter than a calm fjord. Compared to the first game there are almost no power spikes: you just drift forward until a Titan appears and casually erases everything, because of course they’re overtuned while magic feels like an afterthought. Unit control exists on paper, but there’s almost no reason to micromanage a single minion — it’s like being offered the wheel on a self-driving bus that’s already on rails. Even some artifacts land with all the impact of a wet birch twig in the sauna. Overall? It’s not terrible, but it’s also nowhere near living up to its own ideas — or to the first part. I’d mark it as “mixed” at best and maybe pick it up with a deep discount, the kind you celebrate with cloudberries and a rare sunny day.

作为1代全成就的玩家，对2代很失望 1代的不少问题都没有改善，制作组匆匆忙忙出了1个看起来也很半成品的2代游戏。 游戏新增了巨人机制，增加了不少新的种族，但是整体游戏性和一代相比没有任何提升，无非是多开了几张图，多加了几个圣遗物。游戏最核心的问题一个也没改。 1. 不同怪物的融合没有任何意义，说是可以随便融合，但是融合在一起也没有任何实质性的提升，玩家需要做的其实也就是尝试把对应亡灵的身体拼在一起解锁配方。而且游戏里面很多时候就给你缺1只胳膊或者缺1条腿，就不让你解锁配方，让人火大。 2. 操作感极差，主要问题是亡灵移动速度太慢，地图太大太空旷，前期分不出精力去操控亡灵，后期可以操控了能干的事情又太少。 3. 赚钱的曲线有点差，后期赚钱升级纯折磨，消磨玩家的耐心。

Starts interesting and great. Becomes grindy, repetitive, idle, tiring. Secret recipes you say? Yay... that is, until you realize how hard it is to discover them, even after hundreds of combinations had only one. The game is too small to even discover the 300+ recipes. And even if you do it, by early figuring out how, the mechanics are making them instantly useless. There are artifacts making your monsters more powerful, than recipes... so why create a 1- or 2-races monster for minimal boosts like less than 10 of some stat, when an artifact with a 3-race monster gives you +1000HP which beats every other stat gaining? Not much to do except just putting 5 parts together and at some so tiring to do even that, you can just pick 5 by random and not worry, in the end you make it even like this. And while this has been early on interesting, the game is essentially broken. Gaining the titans, makes your monsters irrelevant on how you usually put them together. Just focus on speed. The game becomes now simply a "let-the-big-one-just-destroy-anything" simulator. Feels like a started-but-never-finished game... potentials missed everywhere. Bad stat leveling, bad balancing between features and game mechanics. The game has no depth. And the story? Well, quite disappointing at the end...

In order to defend your tower and discover the map you create minions by putting together different body parts. There are quite a few different races and variants within those races. There are only three maps but there is still hours of gameplay to be had. Definitely worth giving it a try if you like TD games!

I got it on sale for 2.40. At that price, phenomenal game. It's very unique and original, I just wish there was an endgame. You beat the final boss, that's pretty much the end of the game. There is a chaos mode, but I've found Chaos mode easier than the final level, and even if Chaos Mode does immediately send the hardest enemies at you once you stabilize you have nothing to do. If you clear the whole map you instantly lose. If this game had a prestige system or a high score board or legit ANYTHING to give it replayability it'd be a favorite of mine for sure, but the lack of end game and some QoL disappoints me a little bit. If this game had mod support I'm also sure that could fix all of its problems. I kinda also ran into the issue where like, as I was unlocking the best units (titan parts) I had already beaten the game, which creates that classic video game issue of... Getting the ultimate gear for beating the game, but then there's no more game to play. I personally didn't find the game as difficult or RNG focused as some of the other reviews suggest, so your mileage may vary. I really hope to see more content added, or mod support, or a 3rd installment. I did not play the 1st game. I think the ideas and concepts here are insanely good and the core gameplay loop itself could be scaled up to be a legit staple in people's favorites, but as it is... I've emptied the game of content in about 20 hours, and the last like 2 or 3 of that was just making a 2nd save to fight a boss for an achievement. Still though, for $2.40 it's a crazy good buy.
